description: v1.4.0 is the cumulative low-latency release. It includes the v1.2.0 rescue pipeline for rejected translation blocks, v1.3.0 cached whole-video context cards plus larger read-only local context, and v1.4.0 latency safeguards: foreground protocol rescue can trigger after the first structural failure, look-ahead prefetch extends to 45 seconds, and normal translation block limits remain unchanged. Also includes compact readable bilingual captions, source fallback, Simplified Chinese default, and main-UI portrait handling.
